roofing-financing-scroll.purpose: Understand the roof estimate, compare terms and decide on the next step without suggesting approval.

beats.title: Start with the project.
beats.body: Ask for a written roof scope before choosing how to pay.

beats.title: Compare the available paths.
beats.body: Consider your own budget and any options the contractor has confirmed.

beats.title: Read the total cost and terms.
beats.body: Look at the APR, repayment term and total alongside the payment.

beats.title: Apply with the lender, if you choose.
beats.body: Use the contractor’s confirmed lender link when you are ready.

beats.title: Confirm your next step.
beats.body: Discuss the roof work and timing before making a commitment.
